name: Kyonyuu de Camp ~Ore no Tent wa Junbi Kanryou! Bijin Oyako to fire!~
original_name: 巨乳deキャンプ ～俺のテントは準備完了！ 美人母娘とfire！～
source:
It's summer break. And suddenly I was given an order from my mother.

"Please go together with your neighbors to their family camp."

Because the husband couldn't go due to work, I must go in his place... Will I be used only for manual labor!?

Is this some kind of joke... Eh, my neighbors are the Hayami?

Then it's different. Both mother and daughter are super beautiful... with big tits! I will go, I will go!

If possible, I can even be the husband's substitute at night...!

But, but, the possibility of that cannot be zero, right!?

At the summer vacation campsite, a 3 nights 4 days heart-pounding experience with beautiful mother and daughter begins!

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=858655]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
现在是暑假。突然，我接到了母亲的命令。

“请和你的邻居一起去他们的家庭营地。”

因为丈夫工作不能去，所以我必须代替他去……难道我只能用来干体力活吗！？

这是什么玩笑吗……呃，我的邻居是速水家？

那么情况就不同了。母女俩都超美…胸大！我去，我去！

如果可以的话，晚上我什至可以代替丈夫……！

但是，但是，这种可能性不可能为零吧！？

暑假营地，与美丽母女的3晚4天惊心动魄的体验开始了！

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=858655]Getchu[/url]]
